name: keyline
description: Interface design laws for coding agents. /keyline init reads your codebase and writes a DESIGN.md in your own token names; audit, smoke, type, color, layout, depth, motion, patterns and polish work through it, with dials set by a preset for your reader (editorial, product or expressive), or the exact Glass system from modimihir.com. Audit scores a screen out of 10; polish works in rounds until it reaches 8. A live guard checks each UI file Claude edits and hands what it finds straight back.
